delta_from_prior: Replaces disjoint-pair product transversals (Neon58 and neon_worstcase_auto_00065, both of which have syntactic twins and collapse to peak 2 under Fable67's pair-consecutive AFO+RCQ reordering) with a minimally-UNSAT, twin-free, XOR-lifted bipartite Fano-plane transversal F(F_7, F_7) (16 vars, 120 clauses -> exact compression to 14 vars, 63 clauses, width 8) that keeps v5's peak >= 8 while resisting both AFO reordering and RCQ twin merging, with only 56 root IALH-5 windows. Also acknowledges the falsification of Neon54/55 near-parity witnesses (peak 0 via global IALH congruences).
explanation:
CODE AUDIT OF PINNED v5 (blq-composed-core-scc-emra-ialh5-v5):
Audited run_counting, compression.py, core_refutation.py, check_scc_and_growth.py, test_elim.py, and test_mra.py by inspection (no execution). No soundness bug was found:
1. compression._verify_certificate builds exact-support blocks from every dense clause of the normalized input, rejects duplicate variables/tautologies, verifies block_clause_counts partitions the quotient, restricts each quotient coordinate used in a block to forms supported inside that block, checks local truth-table equality on all 2^|support| points, and checks P*L=I over GF(2) entrywise. Conjunction over blocks plus surjectivity of P gives exact equisatisfiability.
2. core_refutation.probe normalizes the input, independently checks set(core).issubset(set(f)), requires compress_root(core) to succeed with an all-binary quotient, and only returns UNSAT if two_sat(q) is False; any other outcome returns UNKNOWN and falls back to exact search.
3. ialh_counting.verify_certificate rebuilds UP tables from the normalized formula, verifies every local hull row on every surviving tuple, and checks the dual contradiction u*A in Z, u*b not in Z using exact Fraction arithmetic.
4. Residual search (canon_plus, signed_scc, elim_plus, prune, two_sat) preserves satisfiability; prune only discards g when another retained state h satisfies g => h.

PRIOR CORRECTION & ATTACK ON FABLE67 (AFO+RCQ):
First, I acknowledge the receipt falsifying the prior Neon54/55 K6 near-parity examples: both peak at 0 because width-5 UP tables retain the XOR parity congruence even after deleting an extra point, and the global integer lattice combines all rows across blocks.
Second, Fable67 (fable_worstcase_auto_00067) demonstrated that Neon58's 16-var 48-clause quotient collapses from peak 8 to peak 2 when reordered so disjoint pairs are branched consecutively (1,2, 3,4, ...). The same vulnerability applies to neon_worstcase_auto_00065: both rely on disjoint-pair blocks where paired variables are syntactic twins (enabling RCQ) and resolving a pair yields either an all-zero pair (UNSAT on the opposite side) or three identical residuals (01, 10, 11) that collapse to one state (enabling AFO).

NEW GROWTH FIXTURE — XOR-LIFTED BIPARTITE FANO-PLANE TRANSVERSAL F(F_7, F_7):
To eliminate both disjoint-pair product structure and twin symmetry while staying cleanly within v5's compression and runtime budgets, we replace disjoint pairs with two copies of the Fano plane F_7 (7 vertices, 7 3-uniform lines; every pair lies on exactly one line, every two lines intersect in one vertex):
- Side A logical variables: A_1..A_6 = vars 1,3,5,7,9,11; A_7 = 13 XOR 14.
  Lines: {1,3,7}, {3,5,9}, {5,7,11}, {7,9,A_7}, {1,9,11}, {3,11,A_7}, {1,5,A_7}.
- Side B logical variables: B_1..B_6 = vars 2,4,6,8,10,12; B_7 = 15 XOR 16.
  Lines: {2,4,8}, {4,6,10}, {6,8,12}, {8,10,B_7}, {2,10,12}, {4,12,B_7}, {2,6,B_7}.
- Negative clauses (20 original -> 14 quotient): for each line L of F_7(A) (resp. F_7(B)), forbid L=(1,1,1). Lines containing A_7 expand into 2 clauses with (-13,14) and (13,-14); lines containing B_7 expand analogously with 15,16.
- Positive clauses (100 original -> 49 quotient): for each pair of lines (L_A, L_B), forbid L_A=(0,0,0) and L_B=(0,0,0). Pairs with neither XOR var give 16 width-6 clauses; one XOR var gives 24+24=48 width-7 clauses; both XOR vars give 36 width-8 clauses.
Total: 16 variables (1..16), 120 clauses, max width 8.

UNSAT & MINIMALITY (NEARBY SAT CONTROLS):
In the Fano plane F_7, the minimal hitting sets (blocking sets) are exactly the 7 lines themselves (any 2 vertices hit 5 lines; any 3 non-collinear vertices miss one line, whose complement is a 4-vertex oval containing no line). Thus the 7 negative clauses on A force some line L_A to be all-zero, and the 7 negative clauses on B force some line L_B to be all-zero, contradicting the positive cross-clause L_A U L_B. Moreover, the 63-clause quotient is minimally UNSAT: dropping any single positive clause L_A U L_B admits a SAT model (set L_A=0, A\L_A=1, L_B=0, B\L_B=1), and dropping any negative clause -L_A admits a SAT model (set L_A=1, A\L_A=0, B=0).

EXACT v5 PIPELINE TRACE (DISTINGUISHING COMPRESSION FROM RESIDUAL GROWTH):
1. compress_root SUCCEEDS (no discovery skip): 63 exact-support blocks, max block width 8 <= 8, local space points = 2*(4*8+3*16) + 16*64 + 24*128 + 9*256 = 6560 <= 16384, verification work < 700,000 << 8,000,000. Variables 1..12 are frozen (odd blocks); 13,14 and 15,16 appear only in even blocks (size 2 or 4) with stabilizers e_13^e_14 and e_15^e_16. Every logical form (12 unit forms + 2 XOR pairs) appears in exactly 24 blocks, while every other nonzero form appears in <= 9 blocks. Greedy sorting by (-count, popcount, mask) selects e_1..e_12 (popcount 1) then e_13^e_14, e_15^e_16 (popcount 2), spanning every block annihilator with zero incompatibility and full-rank right inverse. Quotient has 14 variables (interleaved A_1, B_1, A_2, B_2, ..., A_7, B_7) and 63 clauses, eligible for automatic Lean verification.
2. core_refutation.probe returns UNKNOWN (no_clauses_removed) on BOTH the 120-clause original (every block is already a full coset of size 1, 2, or 4) and the 63-clause quotient (every block has size 1).
3. IALH-5 at the root: all 49 positive clauses have width 6 > k=5 and are excluded from windows(); only the 14 negative 3-clauses and their 42 within-side pairwise unions (size 5) form windows, giving just 56 windows and 1456 tuples (half of Neon58's root tuple count, keeping total runtime low). Every window contains 0 and all weight-1 vectors surviving UP, so hull_rows produces 0 constraints.
4. elim_plus & signed_scc at the root: no binary clauses; each variable has |pos|=21, |neg|=3, and 3*14=42 non-tautological resolvents > 24, so elim_plus is STUCK.
5. Residual growth under v5's ascending quotient order (A_1, B_1, A_2, B_2, ...):
   - Layer 1 (A_1): both A_1=0 (|neg|=2, |pos|=21, 28>23 resolvents) and A_1=1 (3 neg 2-clauses, no SCC, |pos|=14, |neg|=3, 28>17) are STUCK -> 2 states.
   - Layer 2 (B_1): all 4 states (A_1, B_1) in {0,1}^2 are STUCK and incomparable -> 4 states.
   - Layer 3 (A_2): (A_1, A_2) in {01, 10, 11} are all STUCK on A (in 11, UP sets A_4=0 leaving a 4-cycle of neg 2-clauses on {A_3,A_5,A_6,A_7} and 2 diagonal lines, 14>9 resolvents), giving >= 6 (up to 8) states.
   - Layer 4 (B_2): all 8 combinations in ({01,10,11} x {01,10,11}) \ {(11,11)} remain STUCK and pairwise incomparable (plus any surviving 00 combinations), yielding expected peak >= 8 (up to 15).
6. Why this also challenges Fable67's AFO+RCQ: F_7 has doubly transitive automorphism group with zero twin vertices (RCQ merges nothing), and even under a single-side-first ordering (A_1, A_2, A_3, ...), branching on 3 non-collinear vertices of F_7(A) retains >= 5 incomparable STUCK states rather than collapsing to peak 2.

SCOPE: This is a finite residual-growth witness on pinned v5, not an asymptotic lower bound or complexity separation.
mechanism_signature: XOR-lifted bipartite Fano-plane transversal F(F_7, F_7): exact root compression succeeds (16->14 vars, 120->63 clauses), core_refutation UNKNOWN on original and quotient (minimally UNSAT quotient), IALH-5 yields 0 root constraints (width-6 positive clauses outside k=5), twin-free and AFO-resistant residual growth (expected peak >= 8 on v5).
